Textbook Exchange

Buy and Sell Second-Hand Textbooks with AI-Powered Price Suggestions and Instant Campus Delivery

User-Friendly Marketplace UI

A clean and intuitive interface for users to browse, search, and purchase second-hand textbooks.

AI-Powered Price Suggestions

An algorithm-driven price suggestion feature that helps sellers set competitive prices based on historical data and market trends.

Instant Campus-to-Campus Delivery Coordination

A feature that enables buyers to select their preferred delivery campus and time slot, making it convenient to receive textbooks on their university campus.

Filtering and Sorting Options

Features that allow users to filter listings by subject, author, edition, and price range, as well as sort listings by relevance, price, or rating.

Admin Dashboard

A centralized platform for administrators to manage listings, user accounts, and payment processing, ensuring a smooth and secure transaction experience.

Rating and Review System

A feature that enables users to leave ratings and reviews for sellers and listings, promoting a trustworthy community and encouraging quality textbook listings.

Secure Payment Processing

A payment gateway that ensures secure transactions and protects both buyers and sellers from potential scams.

Campus Integration

A feature that integrates with university campus systems to facilitate textbook returns, exchanges, and refunds, reducing waste and promoting sustainability.
